provenance.evidence: Original server score code is absent. This explicit approximation preserves distinct color/ingredient rewards, five-point units, and a 400-point hard-mode threshold. Narrated video deltas are hints, not verified native weights. Unknown entries are authored balancing parameters.

rationale: Each color and topping combination has a distinct positive award. Pepper recipes pay more than cheese, and cheese more than tomato; green recipes pay more than red, and red more than blue. Candidate narrated deltas for blue/cheese, red/tomato and red/pepper, and a conditional blue/cheese plus blue/pepper sum, inform those entries without establishing original accuracy. The remaining entries interpolate a bounded five-point scale; completing the challenge still requires genuine requested recipes and a genuine finish.
native_accuracy: Recipe weights are not recovered official values. Native action costs, ingredient capacity, failure rules, score scale and threshold are separate source-qualified declarations.
